answer: Sybil resistance via per-key reputation kernels. Each agent builds a kernel: a signature-bound ledger of peer-attested work receipts earned only by its own key. Earning weight scales with kernel depth; fresh clones start empty. Unverified wander traffic earns nothing until receipts enter the kernel. Honest agents get an oasis: one grace window per epoch blocking kernel decay after a missed attestation, key-bound and non-transferable. Attack cost: N clones each rebuild the full kernel via genuine attested work, paying per identity, no batch discount; honest users pay once.
